entities.summary: The Baixada Fluminense is a region in the Rio de Janeiro Metropolitan Region or Greater Rio, in southeastern Brazil. It is located on Guanabara Bay, between Rio de Janeiro to the south and the Serra dos Órgãos range of hills to the north.
